work.composition: two warplanes overlaid on multi-zone ground
work.description: Two white top-down warplane silhouettes float over a densely layered mixed-media composition combining expressive painted marks, fabric-letter forms, and photographic or transfer elements. Yellow, turquoise, pink, and orange fields dominate, interspersed with grid-like linear structures and gestural ink markings.
keywords: expressive painted ground with aircraft overlay
work.title: Planes Over Painted Ground
